about_the_game:
As a dedicated ghost chef trying to make a living in the afterlife, you decide to open your own restaurant in hell. Day after day and night after night, from one shift to the next, race against the clock to serve more and more hungry customers. Switch to your not-so-secret magic kitchen to prepare more exotic dishes. Start off small, expand your restaurant and your skills, and slowly gain your reputation as the best ghost cooking chief in hell!

Cook dishes and serve hungry customers!

.
.
.
Run, cut meat, fry potatoes, mix delicious smoothies, make coffee, serve customers before they storm out, clean tables, stack dirty plates, wash dishes… You will have a lot on your plate.Different kinds of customers have varying tempers and willingness to give you tips. Serving them is key to the longevity of your restaurant. Every second counts, because if you take too long, your customers will be tired of waiting and they will leave angry and hungry!

Switch to your secret kitchen!

.
Encountering strange orders with venomous mushrooms or magic plants that you don’t have in your fridge? Time to enter your clandestine kitchen! Discover the mystical counterparts to your regular ingredients and kitchen tools. Watch as a regular steak transforms into rotten meat, and a mushroom becomes a venomous variant with red spots. Sprinkle glowing eyes on your donuts, chop garlic, brew magic potions, and create infusions with foxglove or deadly nightshade. Your cauldron and your alembic will help you to craft enchanting recipes and satisfy every customer. Master the art of juggling between both kitchens to ensure your dishes never burn!

Discover a huge variety of ingredients and recipes!

.
.
Discover more than 50 ingredients to cook, each with its magical counterpart hidden in your secret atelier. From familiar carrots, mushrooms, and donuts to exotic items like garlic, blood, or deadly nightshade, a world of exciting ingredients awaits your culinary creativity! You can create more than 100 different recipes from all around the world and even beyond, to offer new dishes and drinks to your demanding customers.

Craft your own menu!

.
Your daily customers are always different! Design your menu however you like based on the day's forecast. Each day, you can choose which ingredients to put on your fridge and on your cupboard, as well as the counters that will be in your kitchen. With more than 10 different personalities, each customer wants something different, and it’s up to you to optimize your menu accordingly. Discover their favorite recipes to gain their trust and unlock their secrets.

Discover magic recipes!

.
Some ingredients and ustensiles have a magical equivalent in your secret kitchen, allowing you to put even more recipes to your menu!

Steal the soul of your customers!

.
When they are done eating, customers take a quick nap. Take advantage of their inattention to absorb a part of their soul! Souls can then be used to improve your restaurant!

Upgrade your kitchen, your restaurant, and your own skills!

.
.
Invest the souls you stole to build up your kitchen with upgrades! These decisions change the way you play and are crucial for unlocking new recipes and increasing your profit. Opt for more storage capacity with a fridge expansion to use more ingredients, or tools like a new blender or more stoves to increase your productivity. You can even invest in an automatic dishwasher! Buy more tables to host more and more hungry customers. Decorate your restaurant with fine taste to increase your customer’s patience… and tips! Take some classes and improve your serving skills to get better tips, or specialize in some recipes and increase your prices. Will you decide to master the art of donuts or to unlock the secrets of smoothies? It’s up to you!

short_description: Hellspresso is a fast-paced cooking game that combines restaurant management with strategic planning and development. Serve and clean tables, design your kitchen, discover new recipes, plan your menu, switch to your secret magic kitchen, gain the trust of your customers and unlock all their secrets!
